text:
If you’re deciding whether to salvage the afternoon outdoors, the morning’s showers have mostly fizzled, but the clouds are still winning, with Burlington sitting near 64. A little sun may break through before the day tops out around 73, though I wouldn’t completely put away the rain jacket until after 2. This evening looks quiet and mostly cloudy, with temperatures slipping into the mid 50s and a light wind turning southerly.

Tomorrow is the bigger weather story. Rain is arriving earlier than it first looked, likely from late morning into the afternoon, with a high somewhere in the low to mid 70s. South winds will build, and the lake could turn choppy with waves up to 3 feet, so today is the better waterfront window. Plan on getting outdoor errands or lake time done this afternoon, and keep tomorrow evening flexible for a wetter, windier finish.
